declared_unknowns.description: The RTL state register has no declaration-time initialization; the test checks unknown output before asserting asynchronous reset. A directed X input confirms procedural-if false behavior; Z input is not separately exercised.
The RTL enters S2, rather than S1, from S4 on input 1, and S0 on input 0; this state transition is preserved.
The default case assigns next_state but leaves out unchanged; invalid state encodings are unreachable after reset.
RTL state parameters S0..S4 are represented by their defaults (0..4); non-default parameter overrides are not implemented or tested.
Clock and reset SystemC ports use bool and are modeled only for binary 0/1 levels; X/Z on clock or reset is outside the modeled verification scope.
